elements.title: Assets, Liabilities, and Net Position definitions
elements.content:
Three side-by-side definition panels connected conceptually by symbols:

- Assets (yellow heading and underline), preceded by a circled plus sign: "the current and future economic benefits owned or available for use by NASA."
- Liabilities (teal heading and underline), preceded by a circled minus sign: "the debts owed by NASA but not yet paid."
- Net Position (dark blue heading and underline), preceded by a circled equals sign: "the activity between revenue and other financing sources, and costs incurred since inception."

The symbols indicate the relationship Assets minus Liabilities equals Net Position.

elements.title: Balance Sheet Components FY 2024 and FY 2023
elements.content:
Stacked vertical bar chart. Chart subtitle/unit: (IN MILLIONS). Categories/periods: FY 2024 and FY 2023. Legend: yellow = Assets; teal = Liabilities; dark blue = Net Position.

Assets | FY 2024 | $27,504
Liabilities | FY 2024 | $7,664
Net Position | FY 2024 | $19,840
Assets | FY 2023 | $26,135
Liabilities | FY 2023 | $6,719
Net Position | FY 2023 | $19,416

Each period is shown as a stacked bar with Assets as the yellow segment, Liabilities as the teal segment, and Net Position as the dark blue segment.
